_comment: parakeet-ultra per-tensor tolerances for compare_tensors.py (finalized Stage 4, 2026-10-04).
CORRECTNESS REGIME
- Reference: kestrel 0.9.1 / kestrel-kernels 0.7.4 (Photon's engine), CPU, float32, torch threads 1,
via scripts/dump_reference_parakeet_kestrel.py at moondream/parakeet-ultra@73175eb.
- C++: models/parakeet-ultra/parakeet-ultra-F32.gguf, --backend cpu --threads 1, F32 compute.
- Attention: TRANSCRIBE_NO_FLASH=1 (manifest cpp_env). The flash path casts the rel-pos score bias
to F16 (~1e-3 rel on enc.final); it is the production speed path and is gated by WER, not here.
- KV dtype: F32 (AUTO resolves F32 on F32 weights).
- Mel: production C++ MelFrontend (no injection).
- Cases: jfk (encoder + decode), dots (35 s) and dots-full (306 s) through the long-form path
(VAD head per 120 s block, pause segmentation, per-segment encoder).
DOMINANT DRIFT SOURCES
- Frontend: the C++ mel is within 2.4e-6 of an fp64 recompute of kestrel's parakeet_features;
kestrel's own float32 torch.stft is off by up to 2.6e-4 in near-silent bins (raw log-mel ~-16,
where log amplifies float32 FFT error in tiny powers). All *.mel / *.mel.in drift is that
reference-side noise.
- Encoder: float32 accumulation order (kestrel fused CPU kernels vs ggml). With an identical
mel input, seg.6.enc.final still differs by 1.6e-5 at one element (6e-5 rel; mean 5e-8).
WIDENED VS STAGE-2 PROVISIONAL (recipe: max(1.5 x observed, provisional, 1e-6))
- enc.mel.in: 0.000263 -> 0.000395 (observed 0.000264). Mechanism: reference float32 STFT noise (see frontend above).
- seg.0.enc.mel.in: 0.00025 -> 0.000524 (observed 0.000349). Mechanism: reference float32 STFT noise (see frontend above).
- seg.5.enc.final: 9.56e-06 -> 1.17e-05 (observed 7.78e-06). Mechanism: float32 accumulation order (see encoder above); localized to a few rows, mean_abs ~5e-8.
- seg.6.enc.final: 9.29e-06 -> 3.38e-05 (observed 2.25e-05). Mechanism: float32 accumulation order (see encoder above); localized to a few rows, mean_abs ~5e-8.
- vad.b0.mel: 0.00026 -> 0.000511 (observed 0.00034). Mechanism: reference float32 STFT noise (see frontend above).
TIGHTENED (1.5 x observed): dec.joint.0 (observed 8.4e-5 / 4.0e-5); dec.lstm.* to the family 1e-6/1e-7 (observed <= 1.8e-7).
EXACT ENTRIES
- dec.embed.0: blank-row embedding lookup (zeros on both sides).
- longform.segments: segment cut points (start sample, count); the segmenter must match kestrel
sample for sample.
STRUCTURAL FIXES FOUND IN STAGE 4 (not absorbed into tolerances)
- Subsampler masking: kestrel zeroes the padded time tail after each strided conv, before the
pointwise conv, at every batch size (KV stt.parakeet.encoder.length_masking=kestrel).
- Pre_encode pointwise convs ran ggml_conv_2d's F16 im2col (3.3e-4 rel); ultra uses conv_2d_f32.
- Valid lengths from n_samples//hop; a trailing invalid encoder frame is masked and not decoded.
